title: After Sirhind, the Khalsa Splits Its Next Direction

blocks.text: With Sirhind broken, the Khalsa must decide what its next march should be. The debate reveals diverging strategic instincts, the clearest of them being that Buddha Dal Singhs opined that the Khalsa must march towards Delhi in order to exploit momentum against major centers of power.

Other factions imagine different horizons, including renewed pressure toward Lahore and other regional objectives. The page thus turns from a single victorious action into a debate about how a victorious confederacy should spend its energy.

It also begins the movement into Episode 154, where territorial assignment and onward campaigning matter more than Sirhind alone. Victory produces not unity of destination, but a widening field of opportunity and disagreement.
